module.Title: Automated Ventilation Challenge
module.Teaching: Combine inspection, a countdown, repeated monitoring, counters, and an emergency break into one ventilation simulation.
module.PredictionQuestion: What protects the monitoring loop after startup?
module.PredictionExplanation: The condition is checked each iteration and break ends operation when necessary.
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the emergency logic, countdown step, loop stop behavior, and counter operator.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the ventilation challenge from memory. Use these exact identifiers: air_quality_ok, cycle_count, emergency_stop, f, minute, print, range, seconds. Use these exact values: 0, 1, 3, 6, "Monitoring minute {minute}", "Ventilation blocked", "Ventilation fan started".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a three-cycle sump-pump sequence that stops on high_pressure. Use these exact identifiers: cycle_count, f, level_high, print, range. Use these exact values: 0, 1, 4, "Pump cycle {cycle}", "Pump sequence blocked".
module.PreviewMessage: Chapter 3 complete: automatic operating sequences are online.
